# Free mask & outfit in Pringles Promotion 2026 (also DE/AT/CH)

![Free mask & outfit in Pringles Promotion 2026 (also DE/AT/CH)](/uploads/620_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update 05/27/2026]** The Pringles promotion has been extended until 07/15/2026 **[Update 01/08/2026]** Apparently the promotion is not only valid in the UK. The outfit could also be redeemed in DE/AT/CH and other countries!

This mask appeared for the first time in the PTS data mining galleries in October 2025. Even then, we speculated what the mask and outfit would be used for. The title was first "Can't Stop", now it's called "**Mr Vault Mascot**" and it's a Pringles promotion. ~~Although it seems ONLY IN THE UK.~~ 

You can get ~~in the UK~~ **free codes in the Pringles cans** which you can then redeem via the QR code and collect your free Mr. Vault Boy mascot. Alternatively, you can simply **scan the code here** while sitting at your PC. Or go to this website on mobile: https://poptopia.pringles.com

![](/uploads/promotion-pringles-games-kin-kstl-banner-germany-de-de-desktop.jpg)

## Free Mask & Outfit: Mr. Vault Boy Mascot

### Mr. Vault Boy Mascot (outfit and head)

Appalachia's most stylish mustache! Put it on now to impress friends and foes alike.

- THIS CLOTHING CAN BE CRAFTED AT ARMOR WORKBENCHES. -

## Pringles Fallout 76 Promo

You can officially find the promo on the Pringles homepage: https://www.pringles.com/uk/promotions.html

The **period** is limited: From **06.1.2026 to ~~07.05.2026~~ 15.07.2026** (date info) you can redeem the codes. The requirements are: Minimum age 18+ years, ~~United Kingdom only,~~ Account registration required, Internet access, smartphone with camera. Promoter: Kellogg Europe Trading Limited. See: Terms & Conditions (PDF).

*Many thanks to **ArlonGR** for pointing out the extended period.* 

In addition to Fallout 76, other items for these games are also included:

- Sea of Thieves
- World of Warcraft
- The Outer Worlds 2

You can choose a reward from these games when redeeming the code. Not all.

### Redemption process

1. Buy a Pringles can (optional)
2. Using a smartphone, visit poptopia.pringles.com and navigate to
“Games” section.
3. Next, log in or register for a Kellogg's account.
4. Choose one of four rewards (from: World of Warcraft, Fallout 76, Sea of Thieves or The
Outer Worlds 2); and
5. Click “Confirm Now”.
6. All eligible participants will receive a unique code for their selected reward on screen.
You must copy this code and follow the next steps.
7. World of Warcraft:
 1. Visit https://eu.shop.battle.net/
 2. Log in or create a free Battle.net® account;
 3. Next, tap “Account Settings” in the drop-down menu;
 4. Paste or enter your unique code in the “Redeem Code” section; and
 5. Tap “Redeem Code”.
 6. The reward will be credited to your Battle.net® account.
8. Fallout 76:
 1. Visit https://accounts.bethesda.net/redeem-code
 2. Log in or create a Bethesda.net account for free.
 3. Next, click on your username in the top right corner of the screen.
 4. Select “Redeem Code” and paste or enter your unique code; and
 5. Click “Redeem”.
 6. The reward will be credited to your Bethesda.net account.
